summary: I finished the half-done merge of uat (SL-039's commits 7fa507f, 88fd772 and d78635f) into slice/SL-040, resolved the five conflicted files, built the result and tested it. Both sides' changes are kept. uat docks OutcomePanel at the top and adds TopLevelPanel as a sibling below it. It also adds the TopLevel* code-behind, the report's TopLevelHeader and topLevel keys, and the hook's watch and measure modes. SL-040's layout inside OutcomePanel (the Grid of star rows), the largest-files code, the report keys and the rescan and expand modes sit alongside. So uat did not rebuild the part of the window SL-040 adds its list to. One real collision showed up: SL-039 had already used window case IDs L-001 to L-003, so the two sets of Test-L00x functions shadowed each other. I renumbered SL-040's six cases to B-001 to B-006. On the merged code, the solution and hook build with 0 warnings and Core.Tests passes 181 of 181. WindowCases -Case All passes all 24 non-network cases (C-001 to C-014, O-016, L-001 to L-003, B-001 to B-006), and HookCases, rules-parity, the rules harness clean scenario and plants F17 to F19 all pass. I did not commit. The merge is still in progress (MERGE_HEAD is present) with no unmerged paths left.

files.why: Merge resolution. OutcomePanel takes uat's DockPanel.Dock="Top" and keeps SL-040's Grid of star rows inside, with its comment. TopLevelPanel, Window.Resources and xmlns:local come from uat unchanged. UnreadableList is the three-way union of the line: MinHeight="40" (SL-040) and MaxHeight="200" (uat).

Merge resolution. Both usings are kept (FsAnalyser.Core and FsAnalyser.Core.Analysis). Both property blocks are kept: SL-040's LargestFilesMs and uat's ShownTopLevel, LastRefresh, SkippedRefreshes and SkipsNextRefresh. Every other hunk merged cleanly. StartScan both hides the largest files and clears the top-level list, and the ending path calls ShowFinalTopLevel and then ShowOutcome, which calls ShowLargestFiles last.

Merge resolution. The report uses uat's Dictionary<string, object?>. The window object holds uat's TopLevelHeader and SL-040's LargestFiles*, UnreadableExpander and UnreadableList keys. The top-level largestFilesShown, largestFileOnDisk and largestFilesMs are dictionary entries, and uat's conditional topLevel block follows. SL-040's local 'rows' is renamed 'largest', because uat's topLevel block declares 'rows' in a nested scope (CS0136). The schema doc lists every key.

Merge resolution. The accepted modes are stop, throw, close, watch, measure, rescan and expand. Run applies uat's FSA_HOOK_SLOW_REFRESH_MS checks first (watch and measure branch, then 'only for watch and measure'), then SL-040's rescan and expand branch, then the armed path. Both sets of methods are kept: SL-040's DriveAfterList, Watch(Window), AfterList, Expand, rescan helpers and State, and uat's WatchList, Watch(ListBox), Measure, ReadRows, Containers, WindowState, P95 and Max. The header documents all of them.

Merge resolution. SL-039's L-001 to L-003 and M-001 are kept. SL-040's L-001 to L-006 are renumbered B-001 to B-006 (function names, comments, the ValidateSet, $HookedCases and the All list), because both slices had defined Test-L001 to Test-L003. $HookVariables holds both FSA_HOOK_SLOW_REFRESH_MS and FSA_HOOK_MISSING.

deviations: SL-040's window cases L-001 to L-006 are renumbered B-001 to B-006. SL-039, already merged into uat, uses L-001 to L-003 for its results-list cases, and docs/design/SL-039-live-results.md cites them. Both slices defined Test-L001 to Test-L003 in WindowCases.ps1. PowerShell keeps the last definition, so after the textual merge SL-039's cases would have silently run SL-040's bodies. Earlier SL-040 evidence that cites L-00x now maps as L-001 to B-001, L-002 to B-002, L-003 to B-003, L-004 to B-004, L-005 to B-005 and L-006 to B-006, and the case commands above use the new IDs.

UnreadableList now has MinHeight=40 and MaxHeight=200. This is the three-way union of SL-040's MinHeight change and uat's added MaxHeight=200, and it reverses attempt 3's removal of the cap. With the list opened in B-003 it measures 74.2 px, well under the cap. LargestFilesList is 95.0 px and UnreadableExpander, UnreadableList and LargestFilesList are all in view, so the O-024 fix still holds.

I ran `git add` on exactly the five resolved files, which changes only the index. Without it they stay unmerged and no commit of the merge is possible. I made no commit, branch, checkout, stash or reset. The merge is still in progress (MERGE_HEAD d78635f) for a person or the engine to commit, and .taad/slices/SL-040/index.json is left unstaged as the engine left it.
not_built: I did not fix the backlog item for the fixed Grid inside a DockPanel, as instructed. The merged OutcomePanel is docked at the top and holds star rows, so it can take most of the window's height from TopLevelPanel, the fill child below it. In C-002 on the merged window OutcomePanel.actualHeight was 369.22 px. The report has no TopLevelPanel height key, so I did not measure how much room the results list is left.
follow_ups: The layout backlog item needs deciding: OutcomePanel (docked Top, with a star-row Grid holding the largest files and unreadable folders) and SL-039's TopLevelPanel (the fill child) now compete for the window's height. A report key for TopLevelPanel/TopLevelList inView and actualHeight would let a window case measure that competition.
Window case IDs are now shared across slices in one script. A per-slice prefix convention (as B- for SL-040) would stop the next slice from colliding with L-/B- again.
